excerpt.zh:
星海共同体已通过太空变形虫保护法案议案，要求帝国与太空变形虫和平共处。

我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Community has passed the Space Amoeba Protection Act resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with Space Amoebas.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?
